messages.content: What is Synapse Tech Inc.?

Synapse Tech Inc. is an AI technology solutions company that builds intelligent business software. Its focus is on decision-making systems that help businesses hire, operate, and secure their operations more efficiently.
What does Synapse Tech Inc. do?
Synapse Tech Inc. builds AI-powered software and enterprise IT solutions. Its work covers recruitment automation, conversational AI, cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, and custom development.
What problems does Synapse Tech Inc. solve?

It addresses slow hiring processes, poor customer response rates, manual security monitoring, and disconnected business operations. The goal is to replace manual bottlenecks with intelligent, automated workflows.
What kind of company is Synapse Tech Inc.?
Synapse Tech Inc. presents itself as an AI-powered enterprise technology company focused on building intelligent systems rather than generic automation tools.
What is Synapse Tech Inc.'s core philosophy?

The company's stated philosophy is that technology should make decisions and execute operations, not just automate isolated tasks. It aims to build AI that runs business operations end-to-end rather than requiring constant supervision.
What areas does Synapse Tech Inc. cover?
Synapse Tech Inc. covers AI recruitment automation, agentic chatbots, cybersecurity, enterprise IT solutions, cloud AI, custom development, and voice agents.
What products does Synapse Tech Inc. offer?
Confirmed products include iRecruit One, Agentic Bot, Coversaction AI, Opira AI, Cyber Security Automation, and Knowledge Fabric.
What services does Synapse Tech Inc. offer?
Synapse Tech Inc. offers Automation, Cloud AI, Custom Development, and Voice Agent services.
Which industries does Synapse Tech Inc. serve?
The site lists Banking and Financial, Cyber Security and Insurance, BPO and Contact Centers, and Retail and E-commerce as the industries it serves.
How do I contact Synapse Tech Inc.?
You can contact Synapse Tech Inc. through the contact page at synapsetechinc.com/contact-us or by emailing info@synapsetechinc.com.
Does Synapse Tech Inc. work with enterprise clients?
Yes. The site describes its solutions as enterprise-grade, covering hiring, security, cloud, and operations for business clients.
What is the difference between Synapse Tech and a regular software company?

Synapse Tech positions itself as an AI intelligence company rather than a tool vendor. Its stated focus is on systems that make decisions autonomously rather than software that still requires manual oversight.
Does Synapse Tech Inc. build tools or intelligence?
According to its own positioning, Synapse Tech builds intelligence rather than tools. It focuses on AI systems that can think, decide, and execute rather than simple task automation.
What is the bleeding problem Synapse Tech refers to?

The site describes three core business pain points: hiring taking too long, customers disappearing without resolution, and marketing spending without clear returns. These are framed as problems its AI solutions address.
Can Synapse Tech guarantee 95% faster screening or 340% more leads?
Those figures appear in marketing material on the homepage but are not confirmed with methodology or sourcing. For verified performance data, contact Synapse Tech directly.
What uptime does Synapse Tech guarantee?
The homepage references 99.99% uptime in its enterprise IT solutions section, but detailed SLA terms are not published publicly. Verify directly with Synapse Tech for contractual uptime commitments.
Is Synapse Tech available 24/7?
The site states that its AI operations run continuously. For support hours, contact Synapse Tech directly at info@synapsetechinc.com.
What does Synapse Tech mean by autonomous AI?

The site uses autonomous AI to describe systems that handle workflows end-to-end without constant human supervision, such as screening candidates, monitoring threats, or handling customer conversations.
Does Synapse Tech replace human workers?
The site frames its AI as eliminating busywork and manual bottlenecks rather than replacing people entirely. It positions the technology as freeing teams to focus on higher-value work.
How do I get started with Synapse Tech Inc.?
The site directs interested businesses to contact the team through synapsetechinc.com/contact-us to discuss requirements and next steps.
Does Synapse Tech have a blog?
Yes. Synapse Tech publishes articles and guides at synapsetechinc.com/blogs.
Where is Synapse Tech located?
The site does not clearly list a physical address on the homepage. Contact them directly at info@synapsetechinc.com for location details.
What is Knowledge Fabric?
Knowledge Fabric is listed as a product on the Synapse Tech site. Detailed information about it is available on its dedicated product page at synapsetechinc.com/product/knowledge-fabric.
What makes Synapse Tech different from other AI companies?
Synapse Tech's stated differentiation is building end-to-end decision-making AI ecosystems rather than isolated automation tools that still require manual oversight.
Can Synapse Tech help reduce hiring time?

Yes. The site describes iRecruit One as an AI hiring platform designed to speed up screening, interviews, and shortlisting. Specific time reductions mentioned in marketing are not independently verified.
Does Synapse Tech offer cybersecurity solutions?
Yes. Cyber Security Automation is one of its listed products, and Cyber Security and Insurance is one of the industries it serves.
Can Synapse Tech help with customer support automation?
Yes. Agentic Bot and Coversaction AI are both positioned as customer conversation and support automation products.
Does Synapse Tech work with small businesses?
The site primarily describes enterprise-grade solutions. Whether Synapse Tech works with small businesses is not clearly stated. Contact them directly to discuss your specific situation.
What is Synapse Tech's privacy policy?
Synapse Tech publishes its privacy policy at synapsetechinc.com/privacy-policy.
Does Synapse Tech have case studies or client stories?
The homepage references a client testimonial from a VP of Operations but does not publish a full case study library publicly. Visit the About Us page or contact the team for more client references.
What is Synapse Tech Inc.'s mission?

Synapse Tech Inc.'s mission is empowering businesses with intelligent advantage. It aims to deliver custom AI-powered business software that learns a business's operations, makes intelligent decisions, and executes autonomously.
Who founded Synapse Tech Inc.?
Synapse Tech Inc. was founded by Hasan A. Khan, who serves as the founding CEO. He previously delivered custom enterprise technology services across manufacturing, healthcare, finance, and retail.
What inspired the founding of Synapse Tech Inc.?

The founding CEO observed that businesses across multiple industries were being held back by complicated technology. Teams were spending excessive time on repetitive tasks, and existing software solutions were overpromised and underdelivered. That observation led to building AI that makes decisions rather than just executing tasks.
What industries did the Synapse Tech founder work in before starting the company?
Before founding Synapse Tech Inc., Hasan A. Khan delivered enterprise technology services across manufacturing, healthcare, finance, and retail.
What problem did Synapse Tech set out to solve?

Synapse Tech set out to solve the problem of businesses being slowed down by overcomplicated software that still required constant manual input. The founding team identified that most AI tools automated isolated tasks but could not make decisions on their own.
How does Synapse Tech describe its approach to AI?

Synapse Tech describes its approach as building intelligence rather than tools. The focus is on AI that understands context, makes intelligent decisions, and executes workflows end-to-end without requiring constant monitoring.
What are Synapse Tech Inc.'s core values?

The site outlines four core values: Innovation First, which means pushing boundaries of AI and digital technology; Secure and Reliable, meaning enterprise-grade security and stability; Global Perspective, designing solutions that scale across diverse markets; and Human-Centered, blending technology with empathy to empower people.
What does Synapse Tech mean by human-centered AI?

Human-centered means Synapse Tech designs its AI solutions to empower people and enhance relationships rather than purely replacing human interaction. It describes blending technology with empathy as a core design principle.
Is Synapse Tech focused on off-the-shelf software?

No. Synapse Tech explicitly positions itself against off-the-shelf software, which it describes as overpromised and rarely changing how a business actually runs. Its stated approach is building custom AI-powered solutions tailored to each business.
Does Synapse Tech build the same solution for every client?
According to the About Us page, Synapse Tech states it has never built the same solution twice because every business is unique. It focuses on custom solutions rather than generic platforms.
How does Synapse Tech describe its relationship with clients?

Synapse Tech describes itself as a partner rather than a vendor. It states clients get a dedicated intelligence architect who knows their business, industry, and goals, and that the team remains closely involved throughout the engagement.
Does Synapse Tech offer dedicated support?
The site states clients receive a dedicated intelligence architect rather than offshore support. It describes an approach where the team is responsive and closely involved in the client's business.
Does Synapse Tech require clients to have AI expertise?

No. Synapse Tech states clients do not need AI expertise on their team. Its model is that clients bring business expertise while Synapse Tech brings AI expertise, and together they build the solution.
How long does Synapse Tech say it takes to see results?

The FAQ on the About Us page states first intelligent decisions in 30 days and measurable ROI in 90 days. These are described as track record rather than a contractual promise. Verify directly with Synapse Tech for specific commitments.
Can Synapse Tech guarantee a specific ROI?

No specific ROI is guaranteed. The site describes measurable ROI in 90 days as a track record but states outcomes depend on scope, implementation, and adoption. Contact Synapse Tech directly for expectations relevant to your situation.
What was the key question that led to the founding of Synapse Tech?

The founding team asked: what if AI did not just execute tasks but made the decisions too? That question led to building AI that understands context and executes end-to-end rather than waiting for instructions.
What does Synapse Tech mean by intelligent advantage?

Intelligent advantage refers to Synapse Tech's mission of giving businesses AI that thinks, decides, and executes on their behalf, turning technology into a strategic asset rather than an operational burden.
What pain points did Synapse Tech observe across industries?

The founding CEO observed that businesses had more software subscriptions than they could manage, automation that still required many manual steps, AI tools that could not make decisions independently, and tech stacks that were fragile and disconnected.
Does Synapse Tech work across different industries?

Yes. The founding background spans manufacturing, healthcare, finance, and retail. The company currently serves banking and financial services, cybersecurity and insurance, BPO and contact centers, and retail and e-commerce.
What does Synapse Tech say about teams spending time on repetitive tasks?

The About Us page references an observation that teams spend approximately 60% of their time on mundane tasks that should not take more than five minutes. This is cited as one of the core problems the company was built to address.
How does Synapse Tech measure success for clients?
The site states success is measured in real business metrics: dollars saved, time saved, efficiency gained, revenue increased, and costs reduced rather than vanity metrics.
What is Synapse Tech's commitment to clients?
Synapse Tech's stated commitment is to grow when the client grows. It describes staying closely involved, thinking ahead, and treating each client's business as its own.
What does Synapse Tech say about decision-makers lacking insights?

The About Us page notes a pattern where decision-makers had rich business data but lacked the clarity and insights to act on it effectively. Addressing this gap is part of the company's founding motivation.
Is Synapse Tech a global company?
The site describes a global perspective as one of its core values, stating it designs solutions that scale across diverse markets. Specific office locations are not listed publicly.
What client results does Synapse Tech reference on its About page?

The About Us page includes three client testimonials. One VP of Operations references hiring 85% faster. One CEO references a 347% return in year one and saving 40 hours per week. One CMO references 4x more qualified leads with 45% less budget. These are client-attributed quotes and are not independently verified figures.
Does Synapse Tech have offshore support?
The site explicitly states there are no offshore support centers. Clients are assigned a dedicated intelligence architect who knows their business and remains closely involved.
What is Synapse Tech's view on building in-house AI?

Synapse Tech describes in-house AI development as expensive and slow, typically requiring specialist hires and years before generating value. It presents its custom AI solutions as a faster and more accessible alternative.
What does Synapse Tech say about enterprise security?
Synapse Tech states its systems are built with enterprise-grade security, ensuring trust, safety, and long-term stability. Specific certifications are not publicly confirmed on the site.
Are Synapse Tech's security certifications like GDPR or SOC 2 publicly confirmed?
Specific certifications such as GDPR, HIPAA, or SOC 2 are not explicitly confirmed in the publicly available information. Verify directly with Synapse Tech for compliance documentation.
How does Synapse Tech describe the problem with traditional AI tools?

The site describes traditional AI tools as requiring experts to operate, automating one process while demanding three more manual ones, and being unable to make decisions independently. They are described as adding complexity rather than reducing it.
What does Synapse Tech mean by AI that executes end-to-end?

End-to-end execution means the AI handles a complete workflow from start to finish without requiring human intervention at each step. Examples given include screening and interviewing candidates or monitoring and responding to security threats.
What is iRecruit One?

iRecruit One is an AI-powered hiring platform built for enterprise recruitment. It automates CV screening, AI interviews, and smart shortlisting to help organizations hire faster, fairer, and at scale.
What problem does iRecruit One solve?

iRecruit One addresses manual overload in recruitment, unconscious bias in screening, lost talent due to slow hiring cycles, and fragmented tools that don't integrate. It replaces time-consuming manual processes with automated, auditable hiring workflows.
Who is iRecruit One built for?

iRecruit One is built for enterprise HR teams, recruitment agencies, and talent operations teams that need to hire at scale. It targets organizations where delays or bad hires have a direct impact on the bottom line.
What are the key features of iRecruit One?

Key features include AI-powered candidate profiling, intelligent resume parsing using Named Entity Recognition, AI voice and video interviews, a smart shortlisting engine with transparent scoring, real-time automation with Google and Outlook calendar sync, semantic matching using OpenAI and HuggingFace embeddings, multi-step workflow automation, and a centralized hiring dashboard.
How does iRecruit One handle resume screening?

iRecruit One uses natural language processing to automatically score skills and experience against job requirements. It can auto-read CVs directly from inboxes and extract structured data using Named Entity Recognition, eliminating manual uploads and data entry.
Does iRecruit One support AI interviews?

Yes. iRecruit One supports AI voice and video interviews. These are role-specific assessments that evaluate technical knowledge and soft skills using speech-to-text and sentiment analysis to ensure objective candidate evaluation.
How does iRecruit One reduce hiring bias?

iRecruit One uses bias-reduced AI scoring with configurable, transparent logic-based rankings. Every screening decision includes a full audit trail so recruiters can see exactly why candidates were shortlisted or rejected, reducing subjective evaluation.
What calendar integrations does iRecruit One support?
iRecruit One integrates with both Google Calendar and Outlook for automated interview scheduling with bi-directional sync.
What is semantic matching in iRecruit One?

Semantic matching goes beyond keyword search to understand actual context in a candidate's profile. iRecruit One uses high-dimensional embeddings from OpenAI and HuggingFace to find candidates with the right experience rather than just matching buzzwords.
How does iRecruit One differ from a traditional ATS?

Unlike traditional ATS systems, iRecruit One includes AI-powered resume screening, voice and video AI interviews, bias-reduced objective scoring, full audit trails per hire, and enterprise security with role-based access controls. Traditional ATS tools typically lack these capabilities or offer only limited versions.
Can iRecruit One handle high-volume hiring?

Yes. iRecruit One is built for enterprise scale and can handle high volumes such as 10,000 or more applications during peak periods without requiring additional recruiters, using bulk resume parsing and automated interview scheduling.
What industries does iRecruit One serve?

iRecruit One serves banking and financial services for audit-ready compliant hiring, BPO and contact centers for evaluating fluency and sentiment at scale, retail and e-commerce for high-volume festive hiring, and automobile and telecom for technical and service-oriented role assessment.
Does iRecruit One provide audit trails?
Yes. iRecruit One provides complete audit trails per hire, including full visibility into scoring logic and decisions. This supports compliance requirements in regulated industries.
What is the end-to-end hiring flow in iRecruit One?

The flow is: job creation, inbox sync, resume parsing, semantic matching, AI screening, calendar sync, voice or video interview, and final shortlist. The platform is configurable per role and provides transparent scoring throughout.
Does iRecruit One integrate with existing HRMS systems?
Yes. The product page mentions API integration with enterprise HRMS systems, particularly for banking and financial services use cases.
How much does iRecruit One cost?
Public pricing for iRecruit One is not listed on the site. Contact Synapse Tech at info@synapsetechinc.com or visit synapsetechinc.com/contact-us for pricing information.
Where can I request a demo of iRecruit One?
You can request a demo of iRecruit One at i-recruit.io or through synapsetechinc.com/contact-us.
Does iRecruit One support role-based access control?
Yes. iRecruit One includes enterprise security with role-based access controls, ensuring the right people have access to the right hiring data.
What is Agentic Bot?

Agentic Bot is a WhatsApp-native AI assistant that automates service requests, policy queries, form collection, and security checks through conversational AI. It is built for enterprise-grade service delivery using a single messaging channel.
What problems does Agentic Bot solve?

Agentic Bot addresses service chaos from manual and fragmented portals, security blind spots where users cannot check breach status, administrative nightmares from unstructured form submissions, and tool fragmentation where separate platforms for service and security increase costs.
What channel does Agentic Bot primarily operate on?
Agentic Bot is primarily WhatsApp-native. It is built within the Meta Business and WhatsApp ecosystem to deliver service intelligence through a channel users already use.
What are the core features of Agentic Bot?

Core features include conversational AI with natural language understanding, form automation using RAG and vector databases to read PDFs, real-time security intelligence for email breach and domain checks, an admin dashboard for analytics and structured submissions, real-time processing, NLP response parsing that converts free-text to structured JSON, multi-step reasoning to query databases or trigger API calls, and automated customer resolution.
How does Agentic Bot handle form collection?

Agentic Bot distributes and collects forms based on user intent directly inside WhatsApp. It reads complex PDFs using Retrieval-Augmented Generation and vector databases, then parses free-text replies into structured JSON data for CRM or admin panel use.
Can Agentic Bot check for email breaches?
Yes. Agentic Bot integrates with APIs that check email addresses against global breach databases and generates email analysis and domain security reports on demand.
What is the execution flow of Agentic Bot?

The core flow is: user message via WhatsApp, intent detection using NLP, knowledge retrieval from verified sources, form delivery, response parsing, structured storage, then admin panel or system action. Every step is automated and auditable.
What technology powers Agentic Bot?
Agentic Bot is built with React Flow for JSON-based version-controlled workflows and LangGraph for stateful agentic execution. It is fully integrated with the Meta Business and WhatsApp ecosystem.
How does Agentic Bot differ from a traditional chatbot?

Unlike traditional chatbots, Agentic Bot supports non-linear governed agents, execution-first design, WhatsApp-based interaction with advanced NLP, response parsing that triggers actions, structured response storage, and enterprise security and control.
Who is Agentic Bot designed for?

Agentic Bot is designed for corporate enterprises, social welfare organizations, insurance companies, customer support teams, and educational and training organizations that need to handle service delivery at scale through WhatsApp.
What industries does Agentic Bot serve?

Agentic Bot serves social welfare and public services for policy discovery and data collection, insurance and financial services for risk assessment and document delivery, customer support and operations for 24/7 automated responses, and educational and training organizations for e-learning and volunteer training.
Does Agentic Bot have an admin dashboard?
Yes. Agentic Bot includes a unified admin dashboard with advanced analytics, search and filter capabilities, and a structured view of all service submissions and security checks.
Can Agentic Bot integrate with CRM systems?
Yes. Agentic Bot parses user responses into structured JSON data that can be sent to CRM systems or admin panels for further processing and action.
How much does Agentic Bot cost?
Public pricing for Agentic Bot is not listed. Contact Synapse Tech at info@synapsetechinc.com or synapsetechinc.com/contact-us for pricing details.
What is Coversaction AI?

Coversaction AI is an omnichannel conversational AI platform that handles customer interactions across WhatsApp, SMS, and voice. It resolves issues, books appointments, qualifies leads, and executes multi-step workflows without requiring human intervention across channels.
What problems does Coversaction AI solve?

Coversaction AI addresses fragmented channels where chat, email, voice, and social tools don't share context, follow-up black holes from manual scheduling and missed reminders, human bottlenecks from high call volumes and limited working hours, and context loss when customers switch channels and have to repeat themselves.
What are the core features of Coversaction AI?

Core features include RAG-grounded natural language understanding, self-managing calendar integration with Google and Outlook, VAPI-powered voice AI with sub-second response times, intelligent lead scoring and CRM integration, live knowledge sync using Playwright scrapers, context-aware human handoff, multi-step workflow logic with drag-and-drop builder, and enterprise integrations including Shopify, OAuth 2.0, and Jira.
What channels does Coversaction AI support?
Coversaction AI supports WhatsApp, SMS, voice, web chat, and social messaging channels, unifying them into a single context-aware platform.
How does Coversaction AI handle appointments?

Coversaction AI manages appointment booking, rescheduling, and cancellation directly integrated into Google or Outlook calendars. Its bi-directional sync automatically manages reminders and calendar updates without manual intervention.
What is VAPI in Coversaction AI?

VAPI powers the Voice AI Call Center capability in Coversaction AI. It provides true low-latency voice agents that transcribe live, summarize intent, and execute actions via voice command with sub-second response times for natural phone interactions.
How does Coversaction AI keep its knowledge up to date?

Coversaction AI uses Python Playwright scrapers that continuously monitor your site. When a price or policy changes, the AI's knowledge base is updated automatically in real time without manual intervention.
What is the architecture of Coversaction AI?

Coversaction AI is built as three specialized microservices: a Laravel backend service for API management, multi-tenant database isolation, and OAuth 2.0 security; a Python AI workflow engine built on FastAPI and LangGraph for agentic decision logic; and a web scraper service that continuously crawls your site to keep the AI knowledge base current.
Does Coversaction AI integrate with Shopify?
Yes. Coversaction AI includes Shopify GraphQL integration for order tracking, cancellations, returns, and CRM syncing directly inside chat without customers needing to visit a separate portal.
Does Coversaction AI integrate with Jira?
Yes. When the AI hits a wall it cannot resolve, it can automatically open a Jira ticket and hand over the full conversation transcript so the human team can continue without starting from scratch.
What vector database does Coversaction AI use?
Coversaction AI uses Pinecone as its vector database for RAG-grounded knowledge retrieval, including document-heavy support for complex policy or contract questions with source attribution.
What industries does Coversaction AI serve?

Coversaction AI serves retail and e-commerce for order lifecycle management, healthcare and clinics for HIPAA-ready appointment automation, real estate for intelligent lead qualification, and BPO and contact centers for document-heavy policy support using RAG.
Is Coversaction AI HIPAA ready?
The product page mentions HIPAA-ready role-based access control for the healthcare use case. Specific certification confirmation should be verified directly with Synapse Tech.
How much does Coversaction AI cost?
Public pricing for Coversaction AI is not listed. Contact Synapse Tech at info@synapsetechinc.com or synapsetechinc.com/contact-us for pricing information.
Where can I demo Coversaction AI?
You can request a live demo of Coversaction AI at conversaction.ai or through synapsetechinc.com/contact-us.
What is Opira AI?

Opira AI is an offline-first LLM platform and private RAG engine that runs entirely on an organization's own network. It allows enterprises to query sensitive documents, compare AI models, and automate AI workflows without sending any data to the cloud.
What problems does Opira AI solve?

Opira AI addresses data leakage risk from third-party LLM APIs, vendor lock-in from single-model dependencies, AI hallucinations caused by lack of grounding in enterprise data, and internet dependency that causes cloud AI to fail when connectivity drops.
Does Opira AI require an internet connection?
No. Opira AI is designed for fully offline deployment. It runs entirely on-premise or in a private cloud with zero internet dependency, ensuring operations continue even when connectivity drops.
What are the core features of Opira AI?

Core features include a multi-model AI chat hub for comparing models like Llama 3 and Mistral side by side, knowledge-grounded RAG for querying enterprise documents with source attribution, fully offline LLM deployment, role-based access control with department-level permissions, LLM-as-a-Service internal API, full audit and compliance logging, model switching and governance, and voice input support for hands-free environments.
Can I compare different LLM models with Opira AI?
Yes. Opira AI includes a multi-model AI chat hub that lets you compare models such as Llama 3, Mistral, or custom-trained models side by side in real time using a vendor-agnostic architecture.
How does Opira AI handle access control?
Opira AI supports role-based access control with department-level permissions that isolate knowledge by role. It includes user-level audit trails for complete visibility and compliance governance.
What is the execution flow in Opira AI?

The flow is: user prompt, model selection engine, private LLM, RAG layer over enterprise documents, policy and RBAC check, response generation, then audit log. No external calls or silent data movements occur.
Can Opira AI be deployed as an internal microservice?

Yes. Opira AI includes an LLM-as-a-Service internal API feature that allows other applications within your organization to call the AI for unlimited tasks without per-token billing or external latency.
Does Opira AI log all prompts and responses?
Yes. Every prompt and response is automatically logged. Opira AI provides comprehensive audit trails that convert chat interactions into structured compliance records for governance teams.
Does data leave the network when using Opira AI?
No. Opira AI is designed so that data never leaves your controlled environment. It runs entirely behind your firewall with no external dependencies, making it suitable for air-gapped deployments.
What documents can Opira AI query?
Opira AI can query PDFs, SOPs, contracts, and other enterprise documents using Retrieval-Augmented Generation with source attribution and zero external calls.
Does Opira AI support voice input?
Yes. Opira AI supports speech-to-text voice input for field operations and hands-free environments such as service bays, warehouses, and remote locations where typing is impractical.
What industries does Opira AI serve?

Opira AI serves banking and financial services for offline KYC and loan policy access, insurance for private risk analysis, BPO and contact centers for real-time SOP-grounded agent support, retail and e-commerce for instant product and policy knowledge access, telecom for outage-proof SOP access, automobile for field service engineer voice queries, and real estate for governed legal document access.
How does Opira AI differ from cloud-based AI?

Opira AI runs entirely offline behind the firewall with no internet requirement, no external APIs, and no data leaving the network. Cloud-based AI sends data through external infrastructure, creating data leakage risk and vendor dependency. Opira AI eliminates both.

Where can I demo Opira AI?
You can request a demo of Opira AI at opira.io or through synapsetechinc.com/contact-us.
What is Cyber Security Automation?

Cyber Security Automation is a continuous security platform that operationalizes open-source security engines into a unified, always-on defense layer. It automates attack surface discovery, vulnerability scanning, threat intelligence, and cloud compliance enforcement without relying on periodic manual audits.
What problem does Cyber Security Automation solve?

It addresses three core problems: structural failures from untracked shadow IT and growing external exposure, manual and periodic scanning that leaves vulnerabilities undetected between audit windows, and alerts without action where tools generate findings but don't remediate them.
How does Cyber Security Automation work?

The core execution flow is: asset discovery, vulnerability and exposure scanning, policy validation, threat intelligence correlation, remediation and alerts, then a logged security state. Every function runs automatically, continuously, and at scale.
What tools does Cyber Security Automation use?

The platform uses Amass and Axiom for attack surface discovery, DNSTWIST for typosquatting detection, Nmap and Nuclei for network and application scanning, STRIX for AI-assisted penetration testing, Robin for dark web intelligence, and Prowler and Cloud Custodian for cloud security and compliance enforcement.
What is attack surface discovery in Cyber Security Automation?

Attack surface discovery uses tools like Amass to perform deep DNS enumeration and infrastructure mapping to identify all subdomains, IPs, and services associated with an organization, including shadow IT and forgotten infrastructure.
What is typosquatting detection in Cyber Security Automation?

Cyber Security Automation uses DNSTWIST to monitor for domain variations that could be used in executive impersonation or phishing attacks, and automatically triggers takedown workflows when threats are detected.
How does Cyber Security Automation handle cloud compliance?

It uses Prowler and Cloud Custodian to continuously audit and enforce cloud security policies across AWS, Azure, GCP, and Kubernetes against CIS benchmarks, and automatically kills or remediates non-compliant resources.
What is STRIX in Cyber Security Automation?

STRIX is an LLM-powered tool used for AI-assisted penetration testing. It uses large language models to identify complex logic flaws in code and repositories that standard scanners would typically miss.
What is Robin in Cyber Security Automation?
Robin is a dark web intelligence tool that monitors the dark web for leaked credentials or compromised assets associated with your organization before they are sold or exploited.
How does Cyber Security Automation differ from traditional security tools?

Traditional security tools run in isolation on schedules without shared memory or enforcement. Cyber Security Automation unifies multiple open-source engines into a single governed execution plane that runs continuously, automatically, and with built-in remediation rather than just generating reports.
What cloud platforms does Cyber Security Automation support?
Cyber Security Automation supports AWS, Azure, GCP, and Kubernetes for cloud security and compliance enforcement.
What industries does Cyber Security Automation serve?

It serves SaaS and technology companies for continuous cloud and application monitoring, financial services for cloud compliance and phishing domain detection, e-commerce and retail for protecting customer-facing assets and payment flows, and enterprises and IT operations replacing fragmented security tools with a unified automated solution.
Does Cyber Security Automation run continuously?
Yes. The platform is designed to run continuously rather than on a periodic schedule. It is described as turning security from an event into a continuous pipeline that runs 24 hours a day.
How much does Cyber Security Automation cost?
Public pricing for Cyber Security Automation is not listed. Contact Synapse Tech at info@synapsetechinc.com or synapsetechinc.com/contact-us to schedule a security review and discuss pricing.
What is Knowledge Fabric?

Knowledge Fabric is a no-code AI knowledge management platform that transforms scattered enterprise documents, websites, SharePoint libraries, OneDrive files, images, and business content into a centralized, searchable, AI-ready knowledge layer. It powers chatbots, copilots, enterprise search, and RAG systems.
What problem does Knowledge Fabric solve?

Knowledge Fabric solves the problem of enterprise knowledge being scattered across PDFs, SharePoint, websites, spreadsheets, and internal repositories. Without a unified knowledge layer, AI systems hallucinate, employees waste time searching, and every new AI initiative requires expensive custom engineering pipelines.
What data sources does Knowledge Fabric support?

Knowledge Fabric supports PDFs, Word documents, Excel files, CSV files, Markdown files, images, websites, SharePoint, OneDrive, and raw text. It turns content from virtually any source into AI-ready assets.
Does Knowledge Fabric require coding?

No. Knowledge Fabric is a no-code platform. Business teams can manage knowledge ingestion and maintain AI-ready knowledge bases through an intuitive control panel without relying on engineering resources.
What vector databases does Knowledge Fabric support?
Knowledge Fabric supports Pinecone, Qdrant, ChromaDB, and PGVector for vector database deployment, both cloud and self-hosted, giving organizations full flexibility and avoiding vendor lock-in.
What is intelligent document chunking in Knowledge Fabric?
Intelligent document chunking transforms large documents into optimized retrieval-ready segments to improve search quality, context relevance, retrieval performance, and AI response accuracy.
Does Knowledge Fabric support OCR?
Yes. Knowledge Fabric performs OCR processing automatically as part of its data ingestion pipeline, extracting content from images and scanned documents without requiring manual preparation.
How does Knowledge Fabric handle web scraping?
Knowledge Fabric includes automated web scraping as part of its ingestion pipeline to extract content and metadata from websites without manual preparation.
Can I audit what my AI knows with Knowledge Fabric?
Yes. Knowledge Fabric provides transparent knowledge auditing with full visibility into chunks, metadata, sources, collections, and ingestion history across the entire knowledge ecosystem.
What is the core pipeline in Knowledge Fabric?

Is Agentic Bot just a chatbot?

Agentic Bot goes beyond a standard chatbot. It uses multi-step reasoning to query databases, trigger API calls, send notifications, collect and parse form data into structured JSON, check email breach status against global databases, and execute backend actions — all through a WhatsApp conversation. Standard chatbots typically only respond with text.
What's the difference between Knowledge Fabric and a regular file storage system?

A file storage system simply stores files without making them queryable by AI.
